name: Minami Natsumi
source:
Natsumi is the [url=/c98200]player's[/url] childhood friend and also his neighbor. She likes taking care of others, which causes her to be used to cooking lunches and making sweets. Because she's skilled with her hands, she draws as part of the Art Club and sews costumes for the Drama Club. She hates being called "big". 

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
